campaign.surfaceSet: R9-R02 frozen split integration: 16 source-audit feature definitions plus two repaired packet capability definitions, all linked requirement parent cases and crosswalk traces

verifiedFacts.detail: The frozen R9-R02 freeze, bundle, operation ledger, capability and requirement postimage hashes match the recorded pins; the scoped actual-H-R02 review independently replayed the exact 113-operation predecessor prefix and nine R9 repair operations.

Reused the pinned full R7 root integration checks for 16 feature definitions, 52 capability cases, 54 requirement cases, 17 bindings, and 248 retained ordered operation IDs; R9-R02 preserves the 113-operation R8 prefix and adds nine repairs for its two packet capabilities, resulting in 18 definitions, 56 leaf cases, and 58 parent cases. Historical owner rows remain 462.

Across the 16 feature definitions and two packet capabilities, linked parent cases preserve capability ID, case ID, polarity, given/when/then; EDIT-024 correctly maps two leaf cases to each of two parent requirements. Scoped packet review and full-cut child technical reviews independently report parity.

Nine feature definitions use duplicated operation suffixes in positive and negative leaf invocation strings and mirrored requirement cases. AUD-GEN-024 additionally lacks output fields that record the independent license/rights evidence and placement/provider axes.

The earlier COH01-R7-002 finding described an earlier cohort candidate whose crosswalk postimage equaled the live preimage hash 6f6eb626...8a3 while declaring 44 mutations. The frozen R9-R02 postimage is b2a266e6...5672 and differs from that preimage; it is byte-identical to the R8 split crosswalk. Thus the old exact hash/count inconsistency does not recur in this R9-R02 cut. Do not claim that this proves owner adoption or canonical currentness.

PDP-0 remains IN_PROGRESS, has eight stale source pins among 188, and owner decision, root adoption, schema registration, and apply authorization are unset. This candidate technical review neither changes PDP status nor grants owner authority.

findings.finding: All six definitions duplicate operation identity in each positive and negative invocation string and copy it to linked parent cases. The packet repair cases in this same frozen cut invoke the canonical capability ID once, providing the accepted internal pattern.

findings.location: capability postimage lines 127113-127147 and positive case lines 127178-127183
findings.finding: Typed inputs distinguish versioned license/rights evidence and execution placement, and output booleans assert axesIndependent=true and mutualExclusivity=false; however successOutputs does not define observed fields carrying the license evidence or policy decision, provider binding, or LOCAL/HOSTED placement. The positive case has no concrete independent-axis combination. The earlier R7 peer diagnostic licenseAndPlacementSeparate=false is consistent with this gap but its PASS/no-findings disposition contradicts that diagnostic; current feature content is byte-identical across R7, R8 and R9-R02.
findings.repair: Define output fields that record both axes and provider binding, and add a concrete mixed positive case (for example, permitted versioned license evidence with HOSTED placement); retain explicit UNKNOWN behavior for missing or stale evidence. Reconcile the prior contradictory review diagnostic in provenance.
findings.predecessor: R9-R02 frozen integrated candidate and root-directed source requirement for independent, non-mutually-exclusive axes.
findings.acceptanceCriterion: Observable output records actual evidence/policy and placement/provider values, demonstrates a valid cross-axis combination, and preserves adverse missing/stale evidence behavior.
findings.nextLegalAction: Return AUD-GEN-024 to its PDP-0 source owner for definition repair and then create a new frozen review cut.
